hook.name: LaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: Fee hook for launchpad pools. Takes a 1% fee on the input currency of every exact-input swap, split between the token's creator and the platform, each claimable from the hook. Pools are registered at initialization by the launchpad's pool factory; exact-output swaps are rejected. Uses beforeInitialize, beforeSwap and beforeSwapReturnDelta.
